summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its ongoing share buyback program. Over 8-12 June 2026, GSK purchased 1,112,424 of its ordinary shares (31p each) at a VWAP of ~1,929.5 GBp through Citigroup Global Markets. The repurchases are part of a non-discretionary buyback announced 11 May 2026; post-purchase, treasury holds 268.7M shares (6.64% of voting rights). This is a routine buyback update under pre-existing program, not a tender or capital return event. No board recommendation or advisor beyond the broker. Watch for further accumulations or program completion.
